title: potentilla pensylvanica var. paucijuga
intro: Potentilla pensylvanica var. paucijuga, commonly known as Pennsylvania cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species belonging to the rose family. It has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and digestive issues, due to its multiple health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of Potentilla pensylvanica var. paucijuga have been found to exhibit antioxidant, hepatoprotective, and anti-cancer properties.
